jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a motivated and dynamic Sales Representative to join our team in the home construction industry. This role involves engaging with potential clients, promoting our construction services, and closing sales. The ideal candidate will have prior training in sales and a strong interest in the home construction sector. This position offers commission\-based pay, rewarding your efforts directly with your success.

**Duties**

* Actively reach out to prospective clients to promote our home construction services.
* Conduct in\-home consultations to understand customer needs and present tailored solutions.
* Follow up with leads and maintain relationships to foster repeat business.
* Collaborate with the sales team to develop strategies for increasing market presence.
* Maintain detailed records of client interactions and sales activities.
* Stay informed about industry trends and competitors to effectively position our offerings.
* Attend training sessions to enhance sales techniques and product knowledge.

**Requirements**

* Prior training or experience in sales, preferably within the home construction industry.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage clients effectively.
* Self\-motivated with a proactive approach to generating leads and closing deals.
* Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently during in\-home visits and follow\-ups.
* Knowledge of home construction processes is a plus but not mandatory; training will be provided.
* Must have reliable transportation for in\-home visits and client meetings.

Join us as a Sales Representative and be part of a growing company dedicated to delivering quality home construction solutions while earning through your successful sales efforts!

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 40\.0 per week

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
FWD People is a full\-service strategic marketing agency delivering meaningful and measurable results in the health and non\-profit sectors. We take pride in being our clients' trusted strategic partner — staying ahead of the curve, and leveraging our expertise and foresight to help them navigate change and seize opportunities. We approach every challenge with a commitment to innovation, excellence, and empathy, and we seek the same qualities in our leaders. As a fast\-growing, senior team, we're excited to welcome more forward\-thinking individuals who will help us drive growth, foster positive change within our client's industries, and have fun along the way.


As an Account Manager, Animal Health, you will work hand in hand with clients and internal project teams to cultivate and strengthen relationships by providing outstanding agency service and effective project management. You will manage timelines, internal reviews, and regulatory processes, while deepening your understanding of brand strategy, veterinary/scientific context, and animal health marketing. You will run smaller initiatives independently and partner closely with (Associate) Account Directors on more complex programs.

**What You’ll Do:**
-------------------

* Provide support across multiple accounts by stewarding projects internally and externally, ensuring a successful execution and delivery on numerous fast\-paced projects.
* Act as a supporting point of contact for clients, responding promptly and communicating proactively to ensure their needs are met.
* Drive project management across projects by managing timelines, team deliverables, budgets, and staffing plans, while proactively addressing any issues that arise.
* Manage cross\-functional project teams to deliver high\-quality assets and deliverables.
* Establish strong relationships and an in\-depth understanding of our clients and their industries, client competitors' strategies, and market conditions, and leverage this understanding to guide internal team efforts in collaboration with clients.
* Support the team with quality control by reviewing all assets before sharing with clients and/or partners to ensure they meet brand standards, client expectations, and quality benchmarks, always maintaining a high standard of excellence.
* Become a specialist in our clients' Legal and Regulatory (MLR) review processes, ensuring clean submissions with previous learnings applied.
* Support business development by seeking out new opportunities and areas for organic growth within your accounts, and contribute to developing proposals and new business pitches.
* Contribute to agency best practice codification including process development and improvement.

**What You’ll Bring:**
----------------------

* 3\-5 years of experience in a similar agency account and project management role, with a proven track record of collaborating across multidisciplinary teams.
* Foundational understanding of pharmaceutical/biotech or healthcare marketing and regulatory (MLR/FDA) environments.
* A natural collaborator who drives and inspires internal teams to successfully deliver multiple high\-value, fast\-paced projects and ensures client goals are met with excellence and efficiency.
* Demonstrated ability to develop, grow, and extend meaningful client relationships.
* Enthusiasm for contributing to business development initiatives.
* Concise written and verbal communication skills across all mediums, internally and externally.
* Excitement about growing new skill sets and leading new types of projects.
* Self\-motivated, with a positive attitude and collaborative nature; able to adapt, think on your feet, and communicate proactively.
* Comfortable working in a fluid environment utilizing soft skills: listening, collaborating, negotiating, and decision\-making.

**Interviewing at FWD People**
------------------------------


We believe in transparency and respect for your time. Our hiring process is designed to be open, fair, and as straightforward as possible, giving you a clear picture of what to expect while also giving us a chance to get to know you. Here’s how it works:

* **Initial Conversation:** A friendly chat to learn about your background, goals, and what excites you about this opportunity (and in general).
* **In\-Depth Interview:** A deeper discussion about your skills, experiences, and how you envision contributing to our team.
* **Scenario Conversation:** A collaborative discussion where we’ll walk through a few real\-world scenarios together. This is an opportunity to show us how you think through challenges, make decisions, and approach problem\-solving.
* **Final Interview:** An onsite conversation with some additional folks on our team and leadership to explore how your unique talents align with our mission and values.


We know that interviewing can sometimes feel overwhelming, which is why we’re committed to keeping the process clear and communicative every step of the way. We’re excited to learn more about you and appreciate you taking the time to get to know us!

**Working at FWD People**
-------------------------


We are a senior team that champions integrity, adaptability, excellence, and growth. Here, you’ll collaborate with solution\-focused colleagues to advance both our clients and our teams.


Our office is located in Brooklyn Heights, and we offer a flexible hybrid work schedule. We value in\-person collaboration and connection but also understand the importance of offering the flexibility to work from home.


We are dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. As an equal\-opportunity employer, we welcome differences in race, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, and more. We believe that diversity drives innovation and success, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunities and fostering a culture of respect and collaboration.

**Benefits \& Comp**
--------------------


At FWD

jobs.title: JPMorgan Private Client Relationship Manager - New York, NY
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

At JPMorgan Private Client, we are devoted to providing distinguished experiences that resonate with our affluent clientele, ensuring they feel valued and delighted by our unparalleled expertise.


As a Relationship Manager in JPMorgan Private Client, you will nurture and develop high\-net\-worth client relationships by earning their trust, comprehensively understanding their unique aspirations, and offering bespoke solutions and tailored advice. You will empower clients to explore the vast financial possibilities their wealth affords, leveraging the formidable capabilities of JPMorgan Chase, including seamless collaboration with partners across various business lines. With an entrepreneurial spirit, you will actively acquire new clients while deepening and maintaining existing relationships, all contributing to the dynamic growth of our business.


**Job responsibilities**


* Cultivate meaningful and enduring relationships with clients, ensuring they receive an exceptional and personalized experience that exceeds expectations.
* Collaborate intimately with clients to discern their unique needs and aspirations, crafting bespoke solutions that support their goals at every stage—whether short\-term, medium\-term, or long\-term—through a comprehensive and personalized planning approach.
* Foster and deepen long\-term primary banking and lending relationships as well as help facilitate the introduction of wealth management services. This includes regularly engaging in in\-person consultations with prospects and clients at their places of business and other locations.
* Present the full JPMorgan Private Client value proposition, attracting and nurturing client relationships while enhancing their overall experience with sophistication.
* Share insights and perspectives on the economy and financial markets with clients, fostering trust and earning their business through informed and strategic guidance.
* Build a robust pipeline through acquiring new relationships, actively seeking opportunities to connect with potential clients and partners and leveraging these connections to expand the client base and drive business growth.
* Network and establish influential connections with referral sources and esteemed contacts outside the office to generate valuable banking and investment opportunities.
* Develop internal partnerships across all business lines to effectively address and fulfill clients' unique needs with precision and expertise.
* Uphold a strong risk and controls environment by adhering to all policies, regulatory guidelines, and security measures with the utmost diligence.
**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**


* Possess 10\+ years in Financial Services, including affluent or complex relationship management and business development.
* Exhibit an entrepreneurial spirit, resilience, and persistence in prospecting efforts to expand business.
* Maintain a high\-net\-worth referral network to develop a new book of business and demonstrate proven success in building trusted client relationships.
* Solve complex financial challenges and present innovative solutions with your astute financial acumen and familiarity with holistic financial planning.
* Demonstrate a passion for guiding clients through what matters most to them and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment to deliver bespoke solutions and exceptional client service.
* The Securities Industry Essential (SIE) exam, FINRA Series 7, and FINRA Series 66 (or 63 and 65\) are minimum requirements. All unlicensed applicants must obtain their licenses through JPMC's licensing program within 150 days of hire, with study materials and support provided.
**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**


* Hold a college degree or military equivalent.
**Federal Deposit Insurance Act:**
  

This position is subject to Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMorgan Chase's review of criminal conviction history, including pretrial diversions or program entries.


**Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act**


This position is subject to the Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act qualification requirements for Loan Originators. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMC's review of your criminal conviction history, credit report, information available through NMLS, and any other information relevant to a determination by JPMC that you demonstrate financial responsibility, good character, and general fitness for the position. Note that any felony conviction within the last seven years will disqualify you from consideration for this position. Your continued employment in this position would be contingent upon compliance with Truth in Lending Act/Dodd Frank Loan Originator requirements.


In addition, this position requires National Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS) registration under the SAFE Act of 2008\. As such, upon active employment with JPMorgan Chase, you will be required to either register on NMLS, or to update your existing registration as necessary to grant access to and reflect your employment with JPMorgan Chase. Your continued employment in this position with JPMorgan Chase is contingent upon compliance with the SAFE Act, including successful registration immediately after your start date, and timely completion of annual renewal and required updates thereafter.


Any information obtained during the registration, update, and renewal processes or through NMLS notifications may impact your employment with the firm. Any of the completed information you provide during the Chase on\-line application process may be transferred, on your behalf, to NMLS by JPMorgan Chase. Please carefully review the information you provide to Chase for accuracy and consistency and with any current NMLS record, if applicable, before submitting. jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative — NYC Tourism & Attractions
jobs.description:
**BRIDGE CITY SIGHTSEEING Outside Sales Representative — NYC Tourism \& Attractions**

Bridge City Sightseeing is building a professional field\-sales team serving New York City’s tourism and attractions market.

We are looking for confident, energetic and dependable sales professionals who enjoy meeting people, working in a fast\-paced environment and earning based on performance.

**What You’ll Do**

Engage visitors face\-to\-face in New York City’s tourism areas.

Ask questions to understand what visitors want to experience.

Present attraction and sightseeing options clearly and professionally.

Convert customer conversations into ticket sales.

Maintain excellent customer service while representing Bridge City Sightseeing.

Learn and follow the Bridge City sales system.

Track individual sales activity and performance.

**Who We’re Looking For**

Candidates with experience in outside sales, tourism, attractions, hospitality, promotions, events, telecom, door\-to\-door sales or other face\-to\-face sales environments are strongly encouraged to apply.

Previous sales experience is valuable, but exceptional communication skills, reliability and coachability are equally important.

Successful candidates should be comfortable approaching new people, working in busy outdoor environments, handling rejection professionally and working toward measurable sales goals.

**Selection Process**

Qualified applicants may be invited to:

* Initial screening
* Sales interview
* Short customer\-approach audition
* Bridge City product and sales training
* Supervised field evaluation

**What We’re Building**

Bridge City Sightseeing isn’t looking for people simply to stand outside and sell tickets.

We’re developing professional tourism sales representatives who know how to approach visitors, identify what they’re looking for, recommend the right experience and provide excellent service from the first conversation through the sale.

**Join the Bridge City Sightseeing field\-sales team and help visitors experience New York City.**

Pay: $56,488\.41 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Professional development assistance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Global Aid Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Flexport:**
-------------------



At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That's why it's our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.



The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------



Flexport.org is the humanitarian arm of Flexport. We serve nonprofits, NGOs, and mission\-driven organizations that need to move impactful cargo reliably, often into some of the hardest environments to reach. As humanitarian and development needs keep climbing, the supply chain expertise our partners can count on matters more than ever.



You'll own some of Flexport.org's most complex and highest\-impact partner relationships. Your accounts span multiple shipping modes and trade lanes: ocean, air, trucking, and customs, and demand real supply chain fluency to navigate well. You won't just manage these relationships, you'll shape them. You bring a strategic point of view to every partner engagement, lead business reviews that drive real decisions, and connect the dots across Flexport's full product suite to help partners do more with what they have. You'll operate with full autonomy, hold a high bar on program growth and retention, and become someone junior teammates turn to for guidance.


**You Will**
------------


* Own end\-to\-end success for a portfolio of complex, multi\-modal Flexport.org partner accounts, including partners with significant program growth potential and high operational intensity.
* Lead RFP bids and contract renewals end\-to\-end.
* Serve as a true strategic partner to nonprofits, NGOs, and mission\-driven organizations, going deep on their supply chain operations to find where Flexport can cut cost, add capability, or move faster.
* Lead high\-impact business reviews (QBRs/MBRs) that go beyond reporting. Bring market context, multi\-modal insight, and recommendations tailored to each partner's mission and constraints.
* Drive expansion across Flexport's full product suite, consistently meeting or exceeding program growth and retention targets.
* Collaborate with Operations, Pricing, Legal, Trade Lane Management, and other Flexport.org teams on solutions that need internal alignment and creative problem\-solving.
* Mentor account teammates: share playbooks, join key partner calls, and help the team raise its game.
* Use AI\-enabled tools to automate and improve internal and partner\-facing processes where it makes the work faster or better.

**You Should Have**
-------------------


* 5\+ years in account management, business development, or a similar partner\-facing role. A background in logistics, supply chain, humanitarian aid, or international development is strongly preferred.
* A track record of independently managing and growing a complex, multi\-product book of business.
* Deep understanding of global trade and supply chain operations across multiple modes. You can speak fluently about ocean, air, trucking, and customs.
* Comfort operating without a playbook in ambiguous or novel situations, and the judgment to write the playbook for others once you've solved it.
* Strong commercial instincts: you spot growth opportunities before partners ask, and you close them.
* Genuine curiosity about the humanitarian and development space. You want to become an expert in aid logistics, not just move freight.
* A natural tendency to develop others. Peers and junior teammates get better from working alongside you.
* A compliance\-first mindset. We operate in a heavily regulated industry, and our partners and regulators need to trust us.

**You Will Get**
----------------


* Ownership of Flexport.org's most complex and meaningful partner relationships, the accounts where the impact is biggest.
* A visible role in shaping how the Flexport.org account team operates. Your judgment and approach set the standard.
* Opportunities to contribute to team playbooks, onboarding content, and process improvements.
* A front\-row seat on Flexport.org's mission: getting aid to the people who need it, on time.
* Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a vibrant company culture.

#### **Commitment to Equal Opportunity**



At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


#### **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants**



Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

jobs.title: Merchandise Coordinator
jobs.description:
TJ Maxx
At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact. Come join our TJX family—a Fortune 100 company and the world’s leading off\-price retailer.

**Job Description:**

**Opportunity: Grow Your Career**


Responsible for executing receiving and merchandising standards while ensuring Associates are processing efficiently and effectively, and working as a team. Ensures an excellent customer experience by engaging and interacting with all customers, and maintaining a clean and organized store. Role models exceptional customer service.

* Creates a positive internal and external customer experience
* Promotes a culture of honesty and integrity; maintains confidentiality
* Orchestrates truck delivery, prioritizing the processing of merchandise onto the sales floor
* Trains and mentors Associates on established merchandising and processing principles
* Ensures merchandise is properly tagged, hung, secured, and coded
* Communicates with the Coordinator on Duty to ensure efficient flow of goods to sales floor
* Ensures Associates complete tasks and activities according to store plan; prioritizes as needed
* Monitors productivity of team and coaches as necessary
* Organizes and rotates back stock for easy replenishment
* Maintains and upholds merchandising philosophy and signage standards
* Maintains all organizational, cleanliness and recovery standards for the backroom area
* Ensures compliance with recycling and, where applicable, hazardous waste programs
* Communicates accurately and effectively with management and Associates when setting and addressing priorities; provides progress updates
* Provides and accepts recognition and constructive feedback
* Partners with Management on Associate training needs to increase effectiveness
* Ensures adherence to all labor laws, policies, and procedures
* Promotes credit and loyalty programs
* Supports and participates in store shrink reduction goals and programs
* Promotes safety awareness and maintains a safe environment
* Other duties as assigned

**Who We’re Looking For: You.**

* Able to work a flexible schedule, including nights and weekends
* Superior communication and organizational skills with attention to detail
* Capable of multi\-tasking
* Able to respond appropriately to changes in direction or unexpected situations
* Team player, working effectively with peers and supervisors
* Capable of lifting heavy objects with or without reasonable accommodation
* Able to train others
* 1 year retail and 6 months of leadership experience


Benefits include: Associate discount; EAP; smoking cessation; bereavement; 401(k) Associate contributions; child care \& cell phone discounts; pet \& legal insurance; credit union; referral bonuses. jobs.title: Account Manager - National & Franchise Accounts
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* 401(k) matching
* Bonus based on performance
* Company parties
* Free food \& snacks
* Opportunity for advancement
* Paid time off
* 401(k)
* Health insurance
  
  

**About us**
SpeedPro Windy City is a large\-format printing and signage studio in Downers Grove. We produce window graphics, wall murals, vehicle and fleet wraps, trade show displays, and signage for clients across Chicagoland and the nation. We are the ones behind the fleet of trucks you see everywhere, and we design, produce, and install the murals and graphics you see at businesses, universities, and sports arenas. We are a small team with big clients, and we are building the side of the business that serves brands with many locations.  


**About this role**
You own our multi\-location relationships: franchise systems, national brands with Chicago\-area sites, property groups, and the agencies that buy for them. These are program accounts. The same graphics package goes into twenty or two hundred locations, on a schedule, to a brand standard, with a purchase order and a certificate of insurance for every site. You are the person who makes that happen and who turns one location into the next forty.
This is a growth seat. You will service the accounts we have, but the job is measured on the accounts you build.
You do not need print experience. You need to have grown a book of business\-to\-business accounts and to like learning how things are made. We will teach you our materials, our methods, and our pricing.  


**What you will own**  


**Account growth**
* Grow existing national and franchise accounts: more locations, more product lines, longer agreements
* Prospect and land new program accounts: franchisors, multi\-location operators, brand and facilities managers, agencies
* Build the relationships that get us specified into brand standards, so the next location comes to us by default

**Program management**
* Scope, quote, and manage rollouts across many sites: site surveys, specs, proofs, production schedules, install windows, and close\-out
* Manage the paperwork that program accounts run on: vendor onboarding portals, purchase orders, certificates of insurance, W\-9s, net terms, and permits
* Coordinate with our office manager and production team so program work flows through the shop without disrupting local orders
* Keep every open program visible: what is approved, what is in production, what is installed, what is invoiced

**Client relationship**
* Be the single point of contact your accounts trust
* Run quarterly reviews with your top accounts; know their rollout calendar before they tell you
* Resolve issues fast and in writing. A missed install at one site cannot become a lost account

  

  

**What we are looking for**  


**Required**
* Three or more years in business\-to\-business account management, inside or outside sales, or client program management, with responsibility for growing revenue, not just servicing it
* Experience with multi\-location, franchise, or program accounts in any industry: uniforms, fixtures, facilities services, promotional products, packaging, point\-of\-purchase displays, commercial furniture, construction services, or similar
* Comfortable with specifications, dimensions, and production files. You will learn our materials and methods here; you need to be someone who likes learning how things are made
* Organized enough to run many concurrent orders across many sites without dropping one. You keep a system, and it is written down
* Clear, direct writer. Program accounts run on email and documentation
* Valid driver’s license. Local travel to client sites and installs
* Based in Downers Grove with flexibility for client visits

**Strong plus**
* Sign, print, graphics, trade show, or point\-of\-purchase industry experience
* Selling to or working inside a franchise system
* Agency\-side production or account experience
* CRM or order management systems. We use CoreBridge
* Familiarity with permits, certificates of insurance, and vendor compliance portals

  

  

**What this is not**
This is not a design seat, and it is not a phone\-bank sales job. It is relationship and program work with a technical product, for someone who wants to build a book of accounts that renews.  


**How to apply**
Send us your resume and, if you have one, a short note on the largest multi\-location account you have managed or grown. If it looks like a fit, we will set up a call.  


SpeedPro Windy City is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Venue Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Venue Event Coordinator takes responsibility for Oak Brook clients after their event has been booked and guides them through the remaining planning process until the event is completed.

This person will serve as the client’s primary venue contact after booking, coordinate all venue\-related details, manage assigned events and ensure the property remains clean, organized and ready for tours and events.

This is primarily a post\-booking coordination and event\-management position. The coordinator is not responsible for prospecting, negotiating prices or independently closing contracts unless management specifically assigns those duties.

CLIENT ONBOARDING

* Welcome and onboard each client after the event contract has been signed.
* Introduce the client to the planning process, important deadlines and venue requirements.
* Explain what information and decisions will be needed before the event.
* Maintain regular communication with clients throughout the planning process.
* Keep clear notes and records of all approved event details.
* Follow up on missing information and approaching deadlines.
* Provide professional, timely and solution\-oriented service.
* Escalate pricing, contract, policy or unusual requests to management.

EVENT PLANNING AND COORDINATION

* Coordinate floor plans, room layouts, seating arrangements and event flow.
* Review linen colors, linen quantities and placement requirements.
* Confirm ceremony, cocktail\-hour, reception and vendor setup details.
* Coordinate approved setup and breakdown times.
* Confirm room access, loading instructions and venue requirements with vendors.
* Maintain a complete and current event file for every assigned event.
* Communicate finalized venue information to catering, operations and other appropriate departments.
* Identify incomplete or conflicting details before the event.
* Conduct final\-detail meetings and approved venue walkthroughs with clients.
* Obtain management approval before committing to exceptions or changes outside established policies.

EVENT MANAGEMENT

* Serve as the primary venue contact during assigned events.
* Arrive early enough to inspect the property and confirm that it is event\-ready.
* Verify that rooms are set according to the approved floor plan.
* Confirm linen placement, table setup, chairs and other venue details.
* Coordinate vendor arrival and direct vendors to approved setup locations.
* Monitor the venue throughout the event.
* Respond calmly and professionally to client, guest or vendor concerns.
* Coordinate with catering, security, cleaning and operations personnel.
* Keep the event running according to the approved timeline.
* Protect the venue and enforce its policies professionally.
* Supervise event breakdown and confirm that vendors remove their belongings.
* Complete a final inspection before leaving.
* Document and report damage, incidents, missing property or maintenance problems.

VENUE APPEARANCE AND READINESS

* Inspect the venue regularly for cleanliness, organization and presentation.
* Ensure the entrance, lobby, event rooms, restrooms and tour areas are clean and presentable.
* Confirm that furniture and venue equipment are stored correctly.
* Make sure the venue is ready before every scheduled tour and event.
* Identify cleaning, repair, maintenance or supply needs.
* Follow up with the responsible employee or vendor until an assigned issue is resolved.
* Maintain organized venue storage, office and client\-facing areas.
* Report unresolved building concerns to management promptly.

TOUR READINESS

The coordinator is responsible for ensuring the property is ready for scheduled tours. Sales personnel may conduct the actual tours unless management assigns the coordinator to assist.

Tour readiness includes:

* Ensuring client\-facing spaces are clean and organized
* Checking lighting, temperature and room presentation
* Removing unnecessary equipment, boxes and clutter
* Confirming restrooms and entrances are presentable
* Reporting maintenance problems before tours begin
* Making sure the venue presents professionally to prospective clients

SALES AND AUTHORITY BOUNDARIES

The coordinator may explain established venue procedures and approved event options.

Unless specifically authorized by management, the coordinator may not:

* Negotiate venue prices
* Provide unauthorized discounts
* Modify signed contracts
* Waive established fees
* Promise complimentary services or upgrades
* Approve outside vendors who have not met venue requirements
* Commit the venue to arrangements outside its policies
* Independently close or sign contracts

Pricing, contract changes and exceptions must be referred to management or the assigned sales representative.

SCHEDULE EXPECTATIONS

* This is a full\-time, five\-day\-per\-week position.
* Friday and Saturday availability will generally be required.
* Sunday availability will be required when events are scheduled.
* The coordinator will normally receive two scheduled days off each week.
* Whenever the event schedule permits, management will attempt to provide one weekend day off.
* The weekly schedule may change based on tours, final meetings and booked events.
* Holiday and evening availability may occasionally be required.
* The employee must obtain approval before working additional hours outside the established schedule.

QUALIFICATIONS

* Previous experience in event coordination, hospitality, catering or venue operations preferred.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Professional and welcoming communication style.
* Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to remain calm and solution\-oriented during events.
* Ability to direct vendors and event personnel professionally.
* Working knowledge of floor plans, room layouts and event timelines.
* Comfortable using email, spreadsheets, calendars and event\-management documents.
* Reliable week

new_jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

At JPMorgan Private Client, we are devoted to providing distinguished experiences that resonate with our affluent clientele, ensuring they feel valued and delighted by our unparalleled expertise.


As a Relationship Manager in JPMorgan Private Client, you will nurture and develop high\-net\-worth client relationships by earning their trust, comprehensively understanding their unique aspirations, and offering bespoke solutions and tailored advice. You will empower clients to explore the vast financial possibilities their wealth affords, leveraging the formidable capabilities of JPMorgan Chase, including seamless collaboration with partners across various business lines. With an entrepreneurial spirit, you will actively acquire new clients while deepening and maintaining existing relationships, all contributing to the dynamic growth of our business.


**Job responsibilities**


* Cultivate meaningful and enduring relationships with clients, ensuring they receive an exceptional and personalized experience that exceeds expectations.
* Collaborate intimately with clients to discern their unique needs and aspirations, crafting bespoke solutions that support their goals at every stage—whether short\-term, medium\-term, or long\-term—through a comprehensive and personalized planning approach.
* Foster and deepen long\-term primary banking and lending relationships as well as help facilitate the introduction of wealth management services. This includes regularly engaging in in\-person consultations with prospects and clients at their places of business and other locations.
* Present the full JPMorgan Private Client value proposition, attracting and nurturing client relationships while enhancing their overall experience with sophistication.
* Share insights and perspectives on the economy and financial markets with clients, fostering trust and earning their business through informed and strategic guidance.
* Build a robust pipeline through acquiring new relationships, actively seeking opportunities to connect with potential clients and partners and leveraging these connections to expand the client base and drive business growth.
* Network and establish influential connections with referral sources and esteemed contacts outside the office to generate valuable banking and investment opportunities.
* Develop internal partnerships across all business lines to effectively address and fulfill clients' unique needs with precision and expertise.
* Uphold a strong risk and controls environment by adhering to all policies, regulatory guidelines, and security measures with the utmost diligence.
**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Exhibit an entrepreneurial spirit, resilience, and persistence in prospecting efforts to expand business.

**Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act**


This position is subject to the Dodd Frank/Truth in Lending Act qualification requirements for Loan Originators. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMC's review of your criminal conviction history, credit report, information available through NMLS, and any other information relevant to a determination by JPMC that you demonstrate financial responsibility, good character, and general fitness for the position. Note that any felony conviction within the last seven years will disqualify you from consideration for this position. Your continued employment in this position would be contingent upon compliance with Truth in Lending Act/Dodd Frank Loan Originator requirements.


In addition, this position requires National Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS) registration under the SAFE Act of 2008\. As such, upon active employment with JPMorgan Chase, you will be required to either register on NMLS, or to update your existing registration as necessary to grant access to and reflect your employment with JPMorgan Chase. Your continued employment in this position with JPMorgan Chase is contingent upon compliance with the SAFE Act, including successful registration immediately after your start date, and timely completion of annual renewal and required updates thereafter.


Any information obtained during the registration, update, and renewal processes or through NMLS notifications may impact your employment with the firm.
